name: Everlove
source: Everlove is a narrative game of romance and mystery where each choice you make builds your character and brings you closer to one of your four possible romantic liaisons. In solving the complex mystery of who killed your father, will you find love?
translation: 《Everlove》是一款融合恋爱与悬疑的叙事游戏。你的每个选择都会塑造角色的个性，并让你与四位潜在恋爱对象中的某一位更加亲近。在解开父亲遇害这一复杂谜团的过程中，你能找到爱情吗？
